sentences.text:
Raghvendra Singh Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
on 13 February, 2020

Author: Anand Pathak
Bench: Anand Pathak

1
 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 Criminal Revision No.701/2020
 (Raghvendra Singh Kushwaha Vs. State of M.P.)
Gwalior, dated : 13.02.2020
Shri Arun Pateria, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Kshitij Sharma, learned Pp for the respondent/State.
Heard on admission.
Record perused.
The revision is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A. No.1322/2020, an application under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence as well as objections filed on the application.

The applicant has been convicted under Sections 7(3) and 16(1)(x) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced till rising of the court with fine of Rs.500/- and sentenced to undergo RI six moths with fine of Rs.1000/- respectively with default stipulation.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that trial court as well as appellate court erred in convicting the applicant and awarding the jail sentence to the revisionist under the provisions of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
Applicant is ready to deposit fine amount.
He is already in confinement since 03.02.2020.
He is suffering the pain of prosecution for last 10 years.
He undertakes to comply the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.
He has strong case of merits.
Hearing of revision shall take some time to conclude.
He also undertakes to do community THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH Criminal Revision No.701/2020 (Raghvendra Singh Kushwaha Vs. State of M.P.) service to serve the society in meaningful manner.

sentences.text:
Therefore,
suspension of sentence may be granted to the appellant.

At this stage, Shri Pateria, Advocate appearing on behalf of the applicant fairly submitted that being guided by spirit of community service performed by litigants/accused of the High Court whereby they are performing community service by way of Plantation/Hospital Service/Blood Donation/Installation of Water Harvesting System.

He also undertakes to perform community service as a counsel and therefore, submitted that he intends to open up Peoples Provident Fund Account (P.P.F.) of his junior colleagues and to maintain it to the best of his ability.
Therefore, he seeks reiteration of the said spirit in the order.
